description: This file declares utility functions, classes, and enums for handling X.509 certificates, including creation, parsing, and cryptographic operations related to certificates in the Chromium project.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate extension with OID, critical flag, and contents.

methods.name: CBBAddTime
methods.description: Adds a RFC 5280 Time value to the given CBB.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds an X.509 name to the CBB by parsing a comma-separated list of type=value pairs.

methods.name: GetTLSServerEndPointChannelBinding
methods.description: Generates a 'tls-server-end-point' channel binding token based on the certificate.

methods.name: CreateKeyAndSelfSignedCert
methods.description: Creates a public-private keypair and a self-signed certificate with specified subject, serial number, and validity period.

methods.name: CreateSelfSignedCert
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate from a provided key using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: GetBufferPool
methods.description: Returns a CRYPTO_BUFFER_POOL for deduplicating certificates.

methods.name: CreateCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Creates a CRYPTO_BUFFER in the same pool, from data or string input.

methods.name: CreateCryptoBufferFromStaticDataUnsafe
methods.description: Creates a CRYPTO_BUFFER backed by static data without copying.

methods.name: CryptoBufferEqual
methods.description: Compares two CRYPTO_BUFFERs for content equality.

methods.name: CryptoBufferAsStringPiece
methods.description: Returns a StringPiece pointing to the data in a CRYPTO_BUFFER.

methods.name: CryptoBufferAsSpan
methods.description: Returns a span pointing to the data in a CRYPTO_BUFFER.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromBuffers
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a chain of CRYPTO_BUFFERs.

methods.name: CreateCertBuffersFromPKCS7Bytes
methods.description: Parses certificates from PKCS#7 SignedData bytes.

methods.name: DefaultParseCertificateOptions
methods.description: Returns default options for parsing certificates.

methods.name: CalculateSha256SpkiHash
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hash of the subjectPublicKeyInfo of a certificate.

methods.name: SignatureVerifierInitWithCertificate
methods.description: Initializes a SignatureVerifier with a certificate's public key for verification.

methods.name: HasRsaPkcs1Sha1Signature
methods.description: Checks if a certificate has an RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SHA-1 signature.
